name: 분홍 가리비
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A peach PINK SCALLOP, fan-shaped ridged pink top shell with cream rim, shell slightly open showing pale interior, no pearl, no face. Front view oriented upright. Front or top three-quarter view, upright, same orientation throughout. COMMON grade: especially round, lovable and strongly cartoonified, natural recognizable base colors; shrimp must be plump and simplified with BIG friendly eyes and short thick readable legs rather than realistic thin anatomy.  OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle body gently contracting and relaxing, fins and arms folding then opening phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
padding_fix_prompt: Edit this animation sheet ONLY to fix frame padding. Preserve the same pink scallop character and 4 poses, but make EACH scallop MUCH SMALLER, half its present diameter. Output square 2x2 sprite sheet with four identical equal square cells. Place the four tiny scallops at exact quarter centers (25%,25%), (75%,25%), (25%,75%), (75%,75%). EACH scallop width must be ONLY 25% OF WHOLE CANVAS WIDTH (50% of cell width), height no more than 25% canvas height. This requires extremely generous transparent blank space: transparent horizontal band from y=42% to58%, transparent vertical band from x=42% to58%, and blank 10% outer border. Four separate SMALL characters with vast blank gaps. Do not crop. No border or grid line. True transparent background. Keep four shell opening/closing poses and same pink cream brown cartoon artwork. Do not zoom in to fill canvas.
